dialogues.speaker: Roya
dialogues.text: I'm a wholesaler of fruits and vegetables.

dialogues.speaker: Roya
dialogues.text: As you can see, there's a great number of merchant ships in the harbor, and my goods are sold in large quantities to meet the needs of ship crews going on long voyages.

dialogues.speaker: Roya
dialogues.text: I'm used to selling crates of apples, peaches, potatoes, and tomatoes, so if you were to only buy a few, I wouldn't really know how to price them.
